extensionName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the store.

extensionDescription.message: Run a Sitelemetry security audit of the site in the current tab: score, findings and fixes. Audit only sites you own or may test.

uiLanguageTag.description: BCP 47 tag of this translation, set as the lang attribute of the popup and the settings page. Not shown; use the tag of this locale (for example pt-BR, zh-CN).

settingsLink.description: Tooltip and label of the settings button.

notAuditable.message: This page cannot be audited. Open a public https:// website and try again.
notAuditable.description: Shown for browser pages, file: URLs and other non-web tabs.

setupTitle.description: Heading when no API key is stored.

setupBody.message: Add your Sitelemetry MCP API key in the extension settings to run audits from this popup.
setupBody.description: Body when no API key is stored.

noAccountHint.message: No account yet? A Free account includes $SCANS$ security scans per month.
noAccountHint.description: Plan fact from the public plan catalogue.

noAccountHintNoFacts.message: No account yet? A Free account is enough to start.
noAccountHintNoFacts.description: Fallback when the plan catalogue is unavailable.

signUpFree.description: Link to create a Sitelemetry account.

noticeBody.message: Audit only websites you own or are explicitly authorized to test. Each audit is performed by Sitelemetry against the live site and is recorded on the connected account.

noticeCheckbox.message: I own this site or am authorized to test it, and I understand that each completed audit uses one security scan of the monthly allowance.

auditAgainButton.description: Primary button when a result exists.

checkAgainButton.description: Primary button when an audit is still running on the service and only its result has to be retrieved; it starts no new audit.

runningStarting.description: Phase text before the server reports a job.

runningBody.message: You can close this popup. The audit keeps running and the result is stored for this site.

runningOnService.message: The audit is running on Sitelemetry. Results appear here automatically.
runningOnService.description: Phase text once the service has confirmed the job.

busyPhase.message: Another audit is already running for this account; retrying shortly.
busyPhase.description: Phase text when the account has a concurrent audit.

statusQuota.message: Not run: the monthly audit allowance of the connected account is used up

statusPlan.message: Not run: this audit kind is not included in the connected plan

statusVerification.message: Not run: ownership verification of the site is required

statusConsent.message: Not run: the connected account must accept the current audit authorization terms

statusReverification.message: Not run: ownership verification of the site must be renewed

statusScope.message: Not run: the current verification of the site does not cover the requested host-level checks

scoreNotMeasured.description: Shown in the score ring when no score was measured.

severityCount.description: Severity count chip under the score: a number of findings and a severity label (severity_*). Put the label first where an adjective after a number would need a plural form (for example "crítico: 3").

noFindings.message: No findings were reported for the measured checks.

moreFindings.message: $COUNT$ more finding(s) of this result are not shown in this list; the AI fix prompt includes them.
moreFindings.description: Under the top findings: how many findings of this result the popup list does not show, when the AI fix prompt (fixPromptButton) includes all of them. Do not refer to a report elsewhere; none is kept for these audits.

moreFindingsNotShown.message: $COUNT$ more finding(s) of this result are not shown in this list.
moreFindingsNotShown.description: Under the top findings: how many findings of this result the popup list does not show, when the AI fix prompt has to leave some of them out to stay short (the prompt says so itself). Do not refer to a report elsewhere; none is kept for these audits.

findingsNotIncluded.message: Sitelemetry counted $COUNT$ more finding(s) that are not included in this result.
findingsNotIncluded.description: Under the top findings when the service counted more findings than it sent with the result: how many are not included. Do not refer to a report elsewhere; none is kept for these audits.

findingsNoneIncluded.message: Sitelemetry counted $COUNT$ finding(s) that are not included in this result.
findingsNoneIncluded.description: Instead of the top findings when the service counted findings but sent none of them with the result: how many. Do not refer to a report elsewhere; none is kept for these audits.

sectionCount.description: Heading of a collapsible section of the result (passingTitle, notMeasuredTitle) and of a module group inside it: the heading and the number of items listed under it. Keep the heading first; use the parentheses of the language (full-width in Japanese and Chinese) and a no-break space where a line could otherwise start with the number.

sectionCountOfTotal.description: Heading of the passing checks section when fewer checks are listed than the service counted: the heading (passingTitle), the number listed and the number counted, as in "Passing checks (300 of 342)". The same parentheses as sectionCount; no-break spaces keep the numbers together.

passingTitle.description: Heading of the collapsible section that lists the checks that passed (as on sitelemetry.com).

passingOther.description: Group heading in the passing checks for checks that belong to no known security module.

passingMore.message: $COUNT$ more passing check(s) were counted but not kept with this result, so they are not listed here.
passingMore.description: First in the passing checks section when the service counted more passing checks than the extension keeps with the result: how many were counted but are not listed. Do not refer to a report elsewhere; none is kept for these audits.

passingNotListed.message: Sitelemetry counted these passing checks but did not send the list of them with this result.
passingNotListed.description: In the passing checks section when the service counted passing checks but sent no list of them. Do not refer to a report elsewhere; none is kept for these audits.

passingLegacy.message: This result was stored by an earlier version of the extension, without the list of passing checks. The list appears here after the next audit of this site.
passingLegacy.description: In the passing checks section of a result stored by an earlier version of the extension (0.1.2), which kept only the number of passing checks.

notMeasuredNote.message: Unmeasured checks are not counted as passes.
notMeasuredNote.description: Note under the heading when no item has an explanation.

notMeasuredNoteExplained.message: Explained items come from how the site responded (such as a redirect or a firewall) or from a deliberate scan limit, not from an error in the audit. Unmeasured checks are not counted as passes.
notMeasuredNoteExplained.description: Note under the heading when at least one item has an explanation (explain*). It speaks only of the explained items, so it stays true for items shown with the reason the service reported.

nmPillarNotInPlan.message: $PILLAR$: not included in the connected plan

nmModulesNotInPlan.message: Security modules outside the connected plan: $MODULES$

nmVerificationModules.message: Security modules that require ownership verification of the site: $MODULES$

nmModuleStatus.description: Security module that was not (fully) measured: the module name and nmNotMeasured or nmPartlyMeasured.

nmModuleStatusReasons.description: Security module that was not (fully) measured, with the reason as the service reported it (in the report language) when the extension has no explanation for it.

nmNotMeasured.description: Status of a security module the service reports as unavailable.

nmPartlyMeasured.description: Status of a security module the service reports as partial.

nmReasonDetail.description: Small line under an explanation: the reason exactly as the service reported it (in the report language).

nmExplainedLine.description: One not-measured item as a single line of text (used in the AI fix prompt): nmModuleStatus, the explanation and nmReasonDetail.

explanation.example: The site answers these paths with a redirect (HTTP 307), for example to its sign-in page.

detail.example: Reported by the audit: HTTP 307; redirect was not followed

explainRedirect.message: The site answers these paths with a redirect (HTTP $CODES$), for example to its sign-in page. Sitelemetry does not follow redirects for these checks, so they were not measured.
explainRedirect.description: Why path checks (sensitive files, API, admin/login, supply-chain files) were not measured: the site redirected them.

explainRateLimited.message: The site rate-limited these requests (its own protection).
explainRateLimited.description: Why path checks were not measured: HTTP 429 from the site.

explainServerError.message: The site returned a server error for these requests.
explainServerError.description: Why path checks were not measured: HTTP 5xx from the site.

explainNoResponse.message: The site did not answer within the time limit.
explainNoResponse.description: Why path checks were not measured: no response or a timeout.

explainPorts.message: $COUNT$ ports gave no reply: a firewall, usually the site's own, silently drops these connection attempts. This is normal hardening; silent ports are counted neither as open nor as closed.
explainPorts.description: Why the port scan was partial; COUNT is 2 or more.

explainPortsOne.message: $COUNT$ port gave no reply: a firewall, usually the site's own, silently drops these connection attempts. This is normal hardening; silent ports are counted neither as open nor as closed.
explainPortsOne.description: Why the port scan was partial; COUNT is 1.

explainScriptLimit.message: Only a limited number of scripts is scanned per audit; the remaining scripts were not checked and are not counted as clean.
explainScriptLimit.description: Why the leaked-secrets check was partial: scripts beyond the scan limit.

nmUnknown.message: Some requested measurements were unavailable; this result does not say which.
nmUnknown.description: Partial result without details: the only item of the section. Do not refer to a report elsewhere; none is kept for these audits.

moduleEngineNmap.description: Security module name (product name, not translated).

moduleEngineNuclei.description: Security module name (product name, not translated).

moduleEngineZap.description: Security module name (product name, not translated).

moduleEngineWpscan.description: Security module name (product name, not translated).

errorUnauthorized.message: Sitelemetry rejected the API key (HTTP $STATUS$). Check the key in the extension settings.

errorForbidden.description: HTTP 403 from the service. Not described as a rejected key; the service's own message, if any, is shown below it.

errorTimeout.message: The audit did not finish within the time budget. Try again later.
errorTimeout.description: Deadline passed without a job id.

errorTimeoutJob.message: The audit did not finish within the time budget of the extension. Sitelemetry keeps running job $ID$, so no allowance is used again: choose Check again to retrieve its result.
errorTimeoutJob.description: Deadline passed while the service kept the job.

errorNoApiKey.message: No Sitelemetry API key is stored on this device, so nothing was sent and the audit did not run. Add your key in the extension settings and start it again.
errorNoApiKey.description: The stored key is gone when an audit is started or resumed; no request was made.

errorInterrupted.message: The browser stopped the extension before Sitelemetry confirmed a job for this audit, so its result cannot be retrieved here. The audit may still have run on Sitelemetry and used a security scan of the monthly allowance.
errorInterrupted.description: The first call was in flight when the service worker was suspended; the audit may or may not have started. Do not send the user to audits or results in the app; none are saved there for these audits.

errorTransportJob.message: Sitelemetry could not be reached: $MESSAGE$. The audit itself keeps running as job $ID$, so no allowance is used again: choose Check again to retrieve its result.
errorTransportJob.description: Network failure after the service confirmed a job; the job is kept.

errorTool.message: The audit tool returned an error.

errorIncomplete.message: The audit is still running on the Sitelemetry side.

fixPromptButton.description: Button on a completed result: copies a prompt for an AI assistant to the clipboard.

fixPromptHint.message: The prompt is built on this device from this result and only copied to your clipboard. Nothing is sent.

fixPromptCopied.message: Prompt copied. Paste it into ChatGPT, Claude or your coding assistant.

fixPromptCopyFailed.message: The prompt could not be copied automatically. Select the text below and copy it.
fixPromptCopyFailed.description: Shown when the clipboard is unavailable; the prompt field opens below.

fixPromptShow.description: Expander that reveals the prompt text.

fixPromptTextLabel.description: Accessible name of the read-only prompt field.

stepVerifyOwnership.message: Verify ownership of this site in the app (DNS or HTTP challenge) to include the protected checks.

stepAcceptTerms.message: Review and accept the current audit authorization terms for the connected account in the app, then run the audit again.

planFree.message: The connected account is on the Free plan: $MODULES$ public security modules and $SCANS$ security scans per month.

planFreeNoFacts.message: The connected account is on the Free plan.

planQuota.message: The connected account has used its monthly audit allowance. It resets at the start of the next billing period. No audit was started and no allowance was used.

planRequired.message: The $KIND$ audit is not included in the connected account's plan. No audit was started and no allowance was used.

planRemaining.message: Remaining security scans in the current period: $COUNT$.

planPaidIntro.description: Intro to the paid plan list.

planPaidLine.message: $PLAN$ ($PRICE$): $KINDS$; $MODULES$ security modules; $SCANS$ security scans per month.

sentNote.message: Only the site URL, the audit kind and the report language are sent to Sitelemetry.

startError_unsupported_kind.message: This audit kind is not supported.

startError_no_api_key.message: Add your API key in the settings first.

startError_not_acknowledged.message: Confirm that you own or are authorized to test this site first.

startError_unknown.message: The audit could not be started. Try again.

apiKeyHelp.message: Sign in at sitelemetry.com/app, open API key and copy the MCP API key. The key is stored only on this device and is sent only to the Sitelemetry host configured below.

getKeyLink.message: Get an API key at sitelemetry.com/app

baseUrlHelp.message: Leave the default unless you test against a staging deployment.

baseUrlWarning.message: The extension only has permission for https://sitelemetry.com. Another host works only if it allows cross-origin requests from the extension, or if you add it to host_permissions in an unpacked developer build.
baseUrlWarning.description: Warning for a non-default base URL.

keyRemoved.message: The API key was removed from this device.

testForbidden.description: Status for HTTP 403 without a message from the service.

testForbiddenMessage.message: Sitelemetry refused this request (HTTP $STATUS$). Message from Sitelemetry: $MESSAGE$
testForbiddenMessage.description: Status for HTTP 403 with the message of the service.

ackStatusNone.message: The ownership notice will be shown before the first audit.

privacyTitle.message: What this extension sends and stores

privacyItemSent.message: Sent to Sitelemetry only when you click Audit this site: the site origin (for example https://example.com), the audit kind, the report language (the language of your browser) and your API key as the bearer token.

privacyItemStored.message: Stored on this device only: the API key, the base URL, the acknowledgement, the last result per site and a cached copy of the public plan catalogue.

privacyItemNoTracking.message: No analytics, no content scripts and no reading of pages or browsing history. The extension never contacts any host other than the configured Sitelemetry base URL.

privacyItemPrompt.message: Copy AI fix prompt builds the prompt on this device from a stored result and only copies it to your clipboard. Nothing is sent.

privacyItemRemove.message: Remove the key here or uninstall the extension to delete everything it stored.
